WordPress, at the speed of Go

Pursae keeps the parts of WordPress people rely on and rewrites the rest in Go: one binary, one PostgreSQL database and plugins that run in a WebAssembly sandbox.

Why a rewrite?

Most sites spend their time waiting on PHP workers and on the database. A compiled server with a connection pool answers the same pages with a fraction of the memory.

  • The dashboard and the block editor work as before.
  • Themes and menus keep their familiar shape.
  • Caching is built in.

We moved forty sites in an afternoon and our hosting bill halved.

Read the migration guide to move an existing site, or start fresh with the built-in theme.
